purpose: Browse stored multi-drive trips scoped by the workspace vehicle/date selection, compare loaded-page distance and energy, inspect trip summaries, save filter views and export loaded records.
primaryGoal: Understand the selected trips without mistaking loaded-page aggregates, inferred pagination, unavailable measurements or historical records for complete fleet totals or live measurements.

dataSources.name: Stored trip list
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['trips', params]; request forwards AbortSignal and select:safeArray protects null arrays. Handler applies vehicle and pagination plus optional start/end to both fleet and vehicle repository paths. Rows are newest-started first, not ranked by distance. List returns an array without exact total metadata. Page derives historical DataState and never substitutes fatal failure for retained data.
dataSources.units: Distance metres, energy Wh, duration seconds remain raw on wire/cache; monetary cost retains current currency formatting. useUnits/useFormatting and convertDistanceFromSI operate at presentation boundaries.

dataSources.name: Trip summary projection and availability
dataSources.behavior: Totals are recomputed from joined drives, coalescing missing distance/energy/duration to zero. Charge count and cost are vehicle-scoped overlapping charging-session window aggregates, not explicit trip-charge membership. Open-trip aggregation uses NOW when ended_at is null. DTO carries nonnullable numeric totals, nullable name/end, aliases started_at/start_date and ended_at/end_date. No source-level availability flags or exact total count are supplied; frontend cannot recover missing constituent measurements from these aggregates.

dataSources.name: Workspace scope
dataSources.behavior: /trips is range-enabled. Existing header owns range and vehicle; no duplicate selectors are rendered. Page currently consumes calendar start/end, not precise startInstant/endInstantExclusive. Vehicle precedence is URL, persisted valid vehicle, first vehicle; null may occur while fleet resolution is pending or fleet is empty, and page then omits vehicle_id. Date changes reset pagination; vehicle changes do not have a page-level reset.

dataSources.name: Vehicle selection support
dataSources.behavior: Existing vehicle-key query, FAST stale policy, AbortSignal and safeArray; selection support is not a separate trips measurement source. No fleet fetch or mutation was exercised.

dataSources.name: Saved route views
dataSources.behavior: User-owned durable querystring snapshots support apply/clear, create, rename, delete, pin/default and auto-apply of a default only on an initially unfiltered URL. Existing shared mutation toasts/invalidation/broadcast and optimistic delete rollback remain. Audit did not execute any mutation.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Canonical page width/header/action overflow/source notices/loading frame; do not duplicate shell scope or create a competing layout.

components.name: TripStatsBand / TripOperationalBrief / useOperationalMetrics
components.contract: Six numeric raw-source metrics with loaded-page scope/provenance, formatted unit/currency/count context and current OperationalBrief details affordance. Distinguish absent query from resolved zero.

components.name: TopTripsChart / ChartCard / EmbeddedChart / ChartContainer
components.contract: Top ten loaded trips by distance; fixed 280px chart, real data/dataColumns accessibility fallback, shared tooltip/grid/axes, image exports plus explicit loaded-set CSV/JSON. Embedded fullscreen defaults false; no chart-native CSV without exportData.

components.name: TripEnergyPanel / MetricBar / LayoutCard
components.contract: Six highest positive-energy loaded trips relative to largest energy, source names/values and display energy; MetricBar already supports missing values, solid fills, accessible names and reduced-motion animation.

components.name: TripCard / LayoutCard / InlineMetric / Badge / Text / Caption
components.contract: Trip identity, start date, elapsed/in-progress duration, drive/charge counts, distance, energy, derived efficiency and monetary cost; decorative route cue is hidden from assistive technology. Current card contains no navigation action.

components.name: CardGrid
components.contract: Measured container policy, stable trip identity, third-sized packed items, min-w-0 and accessible group label; preserve every card rather than reducing mobile content.

components.name: Pagination
components.contract: Caller-owned total/page/size, localized range announcement, first/previous/number/next/last and direct jump, responsive targets and size options 25/50/100; current total contract assumes an actual count.

components.name: SavedViewMenu / useSavedViewUrl
components.contract: Reuse route '/trips', canonical querystrings, default application, menus/dialogs/confirmations and current save/manage actions; do not invent another view store.

components.name: DataFreshnessAuto / DataSourceNotice / deriveDataState
components.contract: Header freshness, historical source distinction, fatal versus retained refresh error, source recovery and offline/paused status; no query-policy changes.

components.name: FadeIn / PullToRefresh / QueryError / Skeleton / EmptyState
components.contract: Coarse-pointer refresh at scroll top with settled-promise recovery, current reduced-motion handling, localized fatal/empty retry controls and section skeletons. No touch or keyboard acceptance claimed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Page-local timestamp duration parser/formatter overlaps formatDurationRange in lib/dateFormat.ts:357-367. Local code correctly rounds total minutes before splitting hours, unlike helpers that independently round a remainder; substitution must not regress rollover.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse formatDurationRange only after preserving 59.7/119.7-minute carry, open-trip label, invalid-date dash and saved number/locale preferences in focused tests. Do not create a new formatter library.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: List, chart and energy panel repeat loading/error/empty/retry branches but share QueryError/Skeleton/EmptyState already. These are independent presentations of one query, not three queries or competing recovery infrastructure.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain section states and consolidate only a demonstrated repeated presentation need through existing feedback owners; no speculative universal wrapper.

sourceBehavior.detail: Primary chart/energy grid stacks below xl and uses chart span two of three at xl. Viewport classes differ from CardGrid's measured-container behavior.
List title/count flex-wrap; cards keep min-w-0, metadata/badges wrap, metric text uses break-words/overflow-wrap:anywhere.
Shared pagination uses container-based control visibility, a reachable direct-jump form and 44px small-screen controls; not rendered in this audit.

issues.detail: Loading grid uses viewport CARD_GRID while loaded cards use container-aware CardGrid; PageLayout.loading additionally replaces all child bands with the generic PageLoadSkeleton. Neither loaded trip structure nor six-metric/chart/energy geometry is maintained on first load.
issues.fix: Use existing container-aware layout and contextual skeletons while keeping all band headings/source notices available; test narrow shell allocations and transitions, not only viewport width.

issues.detail: Ten bars occupy 280px with an 80px category axis and 10px ticks; long trip names and a narrow chart allocation may truncate/skip labels. Overflow and readability are not visually verified.
issues.fix: Exercise long translated/user names and 320px allocated width; preserve top-ten comparison and actual accessible data rows, and use existing frame sizing/label strategies rather than removing trips.

issues.detail: Energy ladder header uses a nonwrapping flex row with no local min-w-0/break-word policy for the source label and readout. TripEnergyPanel supplies arbitrary trip names; effective overflow is unverified.
issues.fix: Validate long unbroken names in the shared MetricBar; if reproduced, make its existing header wrap or shrink labels safely without hiding the numeric value/name. Page must not fork MetricBar.

positiveEvidence: Three localized section labels and CardGrid group label exist (TripListPage.tsx:153,161,171,198).
TopTripsChart supplies real data/dataColumns and localized ariaLabel; decorative download and route icons are aria-hidden (TripListPage.tsx:346-353,362,366,475-479).
Shared Pagination has nav name, aria-current, range live region, named buttons, jump validation and responsive target sizes (Pagination.tsx:50-60,76-137).
FadeIn and MetricBar explicitly consume motion preference (FadeIn.tsx:24-38; MetricBar.tsx:49,99-103).

issues.detail: Bar lacks isAnimationActive/motion-aware props. chartAnimation at line 378 is a static duration/easing object spread on BarChart rather than the animated Bar. Shared chartAnimationProps already exists in chartDefaults.tsx:53-61.
issues.fix: Apply the existing chartAnimationProps contract to Bar, preserving series geometry and data; test reduced-motion and ordinary animation without relying on CSS to stop Recharts JS.

issues.rule: mission 1 primary goal / MDC-040 navigation reachability
issues.detail: Trip cards expose identity/metrics but no Link, onClick or details action; /trips/:id is registered at App.tsx:677. This audit proves missing card navigation, not an existing action lost in migration.
issues.fix: Integration owner should decide whether this list must expose the already-existing detail route; if approved, use a named native link composed with existing control chrome, not an unlabelled clickable div. Preserve current exports and metadata.

issues.detail: CSV/JSON use Button size sm with wrapping labels but no explicit page-level 44px override. Effective shared sizing/spacing exceptions and open chart toolbar reachability were not exercised.
issues.fix: Measure actual export targets at narrow allocations and 200% text; reuse shared Button density/target policy if they fail rather than duplicating a button implementation.

inventory.name: Initial loading
inventory.behavior: Page loading replaces all child bands with a generic two-panel skeleton. Feature-specific chart/energy/list skeletons remain coded but are hidden during normal first-load page suppression.

inventory.name: Fatal failure
inventory.behavior: QueryError offers refetch in list, chart and energy; summary receives missing values/failure source status instead of fabricated success.

inventory.name: Resolved empty array
inventory.behavior: Query hasData is true for []; loaded-page summary shows zero counts/totals, chart empty, energy unrankable, list no-records with Retry; pagination absent. This is distinct from no resolved query.

inventory.name: Retained refresh failure
inventory.behavior: Retained records remain; summary shows retained source/freshness and shared source notice can offer recovery. Chart/cards do not become fatal-error placeholders.

inventory.name: Paused/offline
inventory.behavior: DataState records isRefreshBlocked; retained pause becomes stale, initial pause remains initial. Source notice distinguishes initial pause, but its hasData path reports ready without considering pause.

inventory.name: Open/in-progress trip
inventory.behavior: Null end_date gets localized In progress duration; date-range inclusion is trip-start based. No live trip telemetry or completion mutation is implied.

inventory.name: Loaded page without positive energy
inventory.behavior: Energy panel displays No energy data to rank yet for all-zero/nonpositive-energy loaded rows; cards/list and distance comparison remain.

issues.detail: Card efficiency renders '0 Wh/unit' when distance is zero, although energy divided by zero distance is undefined. Card cost displays a dash for every cost <=0, hiding genuine zero or signed source cost. Numeric fallback at lines 458-462 also erases malformed/missing inputs; current backend already coalesces aggregate availability.
issues.fix: Keep zero cost visible and preserve signed monetary values according to existing currency semantics; show unavailable efficiency when denominator is not valid positive distance. Coordinate constituent availability with the data owner rather than inventing new cache values or reinterpreting SQL coalesced zero.

issues.detail: Summary cost-per-100-distance context falls back to formatted currency zero when loaded distance is not positive, presenting an unavailable ratio as measured zero.
issues.fix: Retain numeric source cost/distance and show a localized unavailable ratio explanation for a nonpositive/invalid denominator; keep actual zero numerator valid when distance is positive.

issues.detail: resolveDataSourceStatus returns ready for hasData + fetchStatus paused unless isError is also true. deriveDataState marks that same source stale/isRefreshBlocked. TripOperationalBrief shows retained source while the shared notice omits paused-offline recovery; actual offline composed UI remains unverified.
issues.fix: Shared source-notice owner should represent retained-paused sources without dropping payloads, expose a retry where allowed and align labels with DataState. Do not turn paused into fatal failure or measured empty.

visualIssues.detail: Distance bars use a gradient at opacity 0.8; energy MetricBar defaults gradient. DISTANCE_COLOR/ENERGY_COLOR are the current CB-safe blue/orange palette, not the legacy neon palette. Gradient decoration is source-confirmed, not a measured neon/glow defect.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer restrained solid shared chart fill and MetricBar fill='solid', keeping CB-safe distinctions and every comparison/readout. Use existing palette/tokens; do not reset persisted palette preferences or create new hex colors.

visualIssues.detail: Every card repeats a cyan tinted/ringed decorative route icon, amber energy text and emerald cost text (lines 476-479,511,523), independent of source state/theme. These are toned fixed accents, not proof of neon or glow, but spend visual intensity on ordinary metadata.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic surface/border/text-secondary/primary tokens for decorative route chrome and routine monetary/energy readouts; retain semantic info/success badges and chart series meaning. Check composed light/dark contrast before acceptance.

visualIssues.detail: Card values repeat ad-hoc size='sm' weight='semibold' instead of a role variant, despite using shared Text/MetricLabel/Caption. Current layout is not raw HTML typography and should not be replaced wholesale.
visualIssues.fix: Select existing metric/body role contracts with tabular numerals, unit readability and wrapping preserved; do not shrink all measurements or invent a page font scale.

architectureIssues.detail: Page takes start/end calendar strings and passes them at lines 111-112. useRangeState exposes rolling/timezone instants at lines 656-682; apiparams.ParseDateRange supports them and date-only input uses UTC days. Thus header 24h/live scope is not represented by precise rolling bounds and calendar scope ignores local timezone boundaries.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass startInstant/endInstantExclusive through the existing useTrips start/end fields and use the same effective instant identity for pagination resets. Preserve header owner, URL preference semantics, full server filtering and inclusive-SQL adapter; do not add a page picker or client-only filtering.

architectureIssues.detail: estimatedTotal is passed as exact total to Pagination, whose caption says Showing X-Y of total and whose last-page/direct-jump limits assume certainty. Full loaded page manufactures one extra record; an empty later page removes Pagination entirely at line 209, leaving no local Previous recovery.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve next/previous/size/direct-navigation capabilities while truthfully identifying unknown totals. Shared owner should accept an explicit unknown/estimated-total mode, or integration should provide genuine count metadata. Keep recovery reachable on an empty out-of-range page and do not label the estimate as an exact count.

architectureIssues.detail: previousRange/effect resets only startDate/endDate, not vehicleId. useSelectedVehicle writes a new vehicle while preserving unrelated page query parameters. Switching to a smaller vehicle result set can retain a high offset and yield an empty grid with pagination hidden.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate atomic page reset with actual vehicle/effective-range changes while preserving explicitly restored saved-view pagination. Test vehicle switch, range commit, rolling clock refresh and saved-view apply rather than blindly clearing all URL state.

architectureIssues.detail: useUrlNumber accepts every finite value, including zero, negative and fractional sizes/pages (useUrlState.ts:168-181). useTrips omits nonpositive limit/offset, server falls back to limit 50 and caps accepted size at 1000, while shared Pagination separately sanitizes display. For example size=0 yields estimatedTotal=1 for a nonempty response even though the server returned its default-size window; fractional values also disagree with integer backend parsing.
architectureIssues.fix: Validate page as a positive safe integer and size against the supported server/control contract before deriving request offset or count estimate, using existing URL mechanisms and preserving valid deep links. Do not weaken server validation.

architectureIssues.detail: PageLayout.loading removes children and DataSourceNotice through PageContainer's loading branch. The feature already owns contextual states but first-load suppression hides them, and shared header freshness alone does not prove an equivalent first-load offline recovery.
architectureIssues.fix: Prefer non-destructive busy/announcement plus section skeletons/source notice instead of suppressing all bands; preserve loading announcements and layout identity. Verify initial pause behavior for the installed query version before claiming an offline defect.

architectureIssues.detail: Page defines TripStatsBand, TopTripsChart, TripEnergyPanel and TripCard in the same 532-line file. Only one component is exported, so this is not a multiple-export violation, but parsing/ranking/formatting/export projection and JSX are coupled to the orchestrator.
architectureIssues.fix: If decomposing, extract page-local domain components under this feature with typed props while retaining all section/action/data behavior and combined source inventory; reuse existing TripOperationalBrief and shared composites, not replacement wrappers.

order: Correct workspace instant forwarding and scope/pagination recovery while preserving header/URL ownership.
Make count uncertainty, zero monetary values and undefined efficiency truthful.
Retain sections during initial/loading/paused states and align shared retained-pause notice.
Use existing reduced-motion Bar contract; test narrow/long-label controls and chart fallback.
Remove repeated decorative accents and unnecessary gradients through existing tokens/contracts.
priority.acceptance: Source-only audit; implementation, runtime and visual acceptance are not established.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Truthful unknown-total pagination contract
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Existing total:number contract and exact-count caption cannot represent the trip endpoint's known loaded count plus uncertain next page.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Extend the existing control only after integration chooses count metadata versus explicit uncertainty; no replacement paginator.
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Retain existing page/pageSize/onPageChange/onPageSizeChange exact-total mode; an additive explicit totalKind/hasNextPage contract must announce loaded/unknown totals, avoid invented last-page limits, preserve previous/next/size and any valid jump semantics, and remain reachable on an empty requested page.
dependsOn: Existing localized pagination labels and keyboard/target policy
acceptance: Full loaded page is possibly truncated, not proof of another record
Empty later page permits previous-page recovery

requiredSharedChanges.name: Retained paused query source notice
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Retained paused sources are currently ready here but stale/refresh-blocked in deriveDataState.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Align paused-with-retained-data source semantics in the existing notice rather than adding a trip-local offline component.
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing sources[].query and retry callback; distinguish initial paused, retained paused, refreshing, refresh failure, ready and fatal failure. Keep retained payload visible and historical provenance intact; localize actual paused recovery without guessing connectivity.
acceptance: Initial pause is unavailable/pending, not measured empty
Retained pause preserves data and announces retained/offline status
Ordinary ready and fatal failure behavior unchanged

competingImplementations.detail: Loading CARD_GRID competes with measured CardGrid geometry used for the loaded list; reuse one existing layout strategy.
competingImplementations.fix: Use the canonical container policy for loading and loaded cards; do not add another grid engine.

competingImplementations.detail: Local formatDuration overlaps existing dateFormat duration functions; preserve documented rollover and open-trip rules before consolidation.
competingImplementations.fix: Use the inspected formatDurationRange owner with preservation tests, not a third formatter.

preservation.sourceHashMeaning: Current repository-root file bytes, not a historical baseline or Git object.

sections.name: Trip summary KPI band
sections.contents: Six metrics: total distance, energy, cost, trips, average distance per trip and charges; trip/drive/charge/cost-per-distance context, loaded-page date/vehicle scope, historical provenance and freshness.

sections.name: Primary distance and energy breakdown
sections.contents: Two independent panels: top-ten distance chart and top-six positive-energy ladder; loading/error/empty/retry and loaded-set exports remain.

sections.name: All trips detail cards
sections.contents: Heading, loaded row count, six initial skeleton cards, fatal/empty retry, all loaded card identities and metadata/metrics.

sections.name: Pagination footer
sections.contents: Conditionally visible current page/size/count/navigation; changing size atomically clears page. Preserve navigation capability while fixing uncertainty/recovery.

actions: Shared header vehicle/date selection, rolling/custom URL ranges and existing preferences.
Saved views apply/clear/default auto-apply/create/rename/delete/pin/default and existing dialogs/announcements.
Header source freshness refresh affordance, section retry and coarse-pointer pull-to-refresh refetch.
Full loaded-set CSV download teslasync-trips-v2.csv with id/name/start_date/end_date/distance_m/energy_wh/cost/drives/charges.
Full loaded-set JSON download teslasync-trips.json preserving raw Trip shape, through current privacy redaction.
Canonical chart image export capabilities; no claim that fullscreen or chart-native CSV is enabled.
Pagination page/size, first/previous/number/next/last and shared jump form; valid URL restoration.
dataBehavior: One historical trip query; retain query keys, cancellation, inherited retries/cache policy and null-array protection.
Workspace vehicle filter and both server date bounds; correct instant semantics without adding local controls.
Newest trip start order for cards; distance and energy rankings are copies and do not mutate source rows.
Summary/export scope is loaded page, not complete range/fleet. Distance chart top ten; energy ladder top six positive values.
All six summary metrics and every card date/duration/count/distance/energy/efficiency/cost survive; local duration carries rounded total minutes into hours.
Raw SI metres/Wh/seconds remain unchanged in JSON/cache/CSV; display conversions and current currency/number/date preferences only at render boundaries.
Backend aggregate zeros and overlapping charging-window cost/count remain documented; do not invent measurement availability.
Fatal error is distinct from retained refresh failure; resolved [] distinct from unresolved data; true zero distinct from unknown or undefined ratio.
No card detail navigation is currently implemented; do not claim it as an action preserved or removed.
